notes: 📱 The phone is now a real phone with a home screen and apps: Messages, Calls, Invite, Map, Feed, Calendar and Weather.
Contacts show live status like Knock Knock: Available, Busy (with what they're doing), Asleep, or With you, plus a colored dot on their picture.
Calls: ring someone and talk live. Free people usually pick up; busy people often can't and text you back; asleep means a missed call. What was said is remembered.

Invitations, ZZZ-style: invite someone somewhere at a time (3 a day). They check their schedule and accept or decline. If they accept they really go there, and if you don't show up they'll let you know (and trust drops).
Map: see which district everyone is in right now and what they're doing.
Feed (Inter-Knot in Krampus): characters sometimes post about their day; you can like, comment and post, and they react and reply.
The narrator knows about your calls, plans and posts.
